katex.why: Clears GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7, fixed in KaTeX 0.18.2. micromark-extension-math 3.1.0 requires ^0.16.0, which excludes the fix; compatible audit updates cannot move it. Keep the first patched release exact because this crosses a 0.x minor boundary. Math HTML rendering and the Markdown gates were verified with this override.
katex.manualCheck: Remove the override when micromark-extension-math admits a patched KaTeX version, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and the Markdown gates.

obsidian.why: The release stream targets Obsidian 1.14.4. Keep the official API dependency exact so reconciliation and bundle checks use that version.
obsidian.manualCheck: Change this pin only when creating or reconciling a release stream for a different Obsidian version.

re2js.why: Clears GHSA-gg6h-894w-4m9c (RE2JS quadratic-time denial of service in lookbehind matching, >=2.2.0 <2.8.7). Reached only through markdownlint, whose newest release 0.42.0 pins re2js at the exact 2.8.6, and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 pins that markdownlint exactly in turn, so no bump reaches the fix. 2.9.1 is the version markdownlint itself moved to upstream, so the forced minor is the one it is tested against. NEVER take the `npm audit fix --force` remedy: it downgrades the toolkit packages.
re2js.manualCheck: The check reads the exact re2js pin of the installed markdownlint, which moves only when a markdownlint-cli2 release pins a newer markdownlint. When it reads 2.8.7 or later, drop the override and this entry and re-run `npm audit`.
